source.text: The search box on the notes list of example-empty

checks.title: Type a word in the search box
checks.why: The box is the whole feature: it narrows the list as you type.

where.text: The Notes page of the running app

do.see: Only the row Milk run stays in the list

checks.fails: More rows than one, or none.
checks.nothingFromHere: The typing happens in your browser.

checks.title: Clear the box with Escape
checks.why: Escape is the shortcut that brings every note back.

where.text: The Notes page of the running app

do.text: Press Escape in the search box
do.see: The box is empty and all four rows are back

checks.passes: Four rows, and the box is empty.
checks.fails: The box keeps the word, or fewer than four rows show.
checks.nothingFromHere: The keypress happens in your browser.
